result.rationale: The migration inserts hosts raw via SQL (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) from the old setting value; the scheme/path stripping only exists in the model's `before_validation` (`self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')`), which never runs for raw SQL inserts. `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` then compares `lower(host) = uri.host`, so migrated entries like `http://discourse.org` (which the old code matched via `URI(h).host`) will never match, breaking embedding on upgraded sites. Mechanism fully verifiable from the diff.
